headline: Claude-Mem Carries Context Across Sessions
lede: Claude-Mem turns an AI coding agent’s scattered session history into a searchable memory system. Local SQLite storage, Chroma retrieval, lifecycle hooks, and progressive disclosure let agents recover the right project context without replaying every conversation.

headline: OpenMausBot Orchestrates a Local Agent Team
lede: OpenMausBot provides the control plane for a team of specialized agents, each with its own model, memory, computer, and permissions. A local harness, approval broker, persistent channels, and reusable templates turn autonomous work into an inspectable operating procedure.

headline: Impeccable Gives Coding Agents Better Taste
lede: Impeccable equips frontend agents with a vocabulary for planning, critique, accessibility, typography, motion, and polish. Deterministic detectors and documented product context push generated interfaces beyond generic cards, gradients, and default SaaS styling.

headline: OpenBot Puts AI Coworkers Behind a Gate
lede: OpenBot gives autonomous agents isolated workspaces, approved tools, and persistent credentials without handing the entire operation to a hosted service. Its gateway records actions across browsers, files, MCP servers, and interfaces, making permission and auditability part of the architecture.

headline: Zi Wei Dou Shu Becomes a Reproducible Engine
lede: This TypeScript engine translates a traditional Zi Wei Dou Shu teaching system into deterministic chart generation and structured interpretation data. Solar-time correction, calendar conversion, school-specific configurations, and large chart datasets make a culturally specific practice inspectable in code.

headline: Expo Skills Maps the Mobile Build Process
lede: Expo’s official skills give coding agents task-specific instructions for building, upgrading, debugging, and shipping React Native applications. From Router and native modules to EAS builds, OTA updates, and crash inspection, each documented procedure loads when the work demands it.

headline: Macro Connects the Modern Company’s Work
lede: Macro consolidates email, messaging, documents, tasks, CRM, code changes, and agents inside one searchable workspace. Its bidirectional links, CRDT collaboration, offline reconciliation, and shared permissions model are designed to keep operational context intact as teams scale.

headline: Skills Brings Engineering Discipline to Agents
lede: Matt Pocock’s curated skills collection packages repeatable practices such as TDD, domain modeling, and requirements alignment for coding agents. Rather than hiding orchestration behind a framework, it gives engineers editable, composable commands for keeping rapid generation answerable to sound process.

headline: T3 Code Gives Coding Agents a Control Surface
lede: T3 Code lets developers operate locally authenticated coding agents from a phone, browser, or desktop while execution remains tied to their own machine. A local server, persistent service mode, broad packaging, and provider integrations make remote agent work feel like a practical utility rather than a new platform lock-in.

headline: DeepTutor Builds a Personal Learning Stack
lede: DeepTutor combines tutoring, retrieval, practice, progress tracking, and source-aware workspaces into an extensible learning platform. Its support for books, repositories, documents, multiple indexing systems, citations, and configurable models gives learners a structured alternative to an undifferentiated chat window.
